JPMorgan Economist Warns Against RBI Rate Hikes Due to 'Sugar High'

Jahangir Aziz, an economist at JPMorgan Chase & Co., has advised caution regarding further interest rate hikes by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Aziz stated that India is experiencing a 'sugar high,' a phenomenon that warrants careful consideration before implementing additional monetary tightening. His remarks suggest that current economic conditions may not be conducive to further rate increases by the central bank.
